name: University of Bristol
summary: A research university in Bristol, south-west England; most courses ask 32–40 IB points, and international students can apply until 30 June.

ib.text: Most courses ask at least 32 points, some up to 40 with 18 at HL; HL Maths AA or AI both count. English A Literature at SL 5 or HL 4 meets English profile E (used by Computer Science).

programmes.name: BVSc Veterinary Science
programmes.about: A five-year vet degree on two campuses: the Clifton city campus and the rural Langford campus, with a small animal referral hospital, dairy farm, anatomy and post-mortem facilities and a clinical skills lab. Case-based learning and placements with many species, ending in supervised core rotations.
programmes.ib: 36 points with 18 at HL, including 6 and 6 at HL in Chemistry and one of Biology, Physics or Maths.
programmes.selectionNote: Academic record (GCSE 10%, A-level 20%) and a scored questionnaire (70%); no routine interview and no fixed work-experience rule, per the 2027 admissions statement.

flagshipSource.title: BVSc Veterinary Science: dual campuses, a referral hospital, dairy farm and clinical skills lab

programmes.name: BEng Aerospace Engineering
programmes.about: Aerodynamics, structures and materials, dynamics and control, and systems and design, applied to aircraft, spacecraft and space missions. It is RAeS-accredited, with company contact through the Industrial Liaison Office and a third-year research project such as landing a UAV automatically.
programmes.ib: 38 points with 18 at HL, including 6 at HL in Maths (AA or AI). Two of HL Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Computer Science are preferred.
programmes.selectionNote: No test or interview is listed. Your UCAS application, predicted grades and personal statement are read. Four-year year-in-industry versions also exist.

flagshipSource.title: Aerospace Engineering BEng: RAeS-accredited, with industry liaison and a third-year research project

programmes.name: BA Liberal Arts
programmes.about: An arts and humanities degree with one subject in depth, your pathway, and freedom to range across the rest. Bespoke units put current global issues in historical context and look at how data shapes stories, and you finish with an interdisciplinary project and a capstone on the public role of the humanities.
programmes.ib: 36 points with 18 at HL. No subject is required; the Music pathway has its own extra requirements.
programmes.selectionNote: No test or interview is listed. Choose a pathway such as English, Film, Classics, Philosophy or a language; a four-year MLibArts adds a year abroad.

flagshipSource.title: BA Liberal Arts: one pathway subject in depth with breadth across arts, humanities and languages

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts, Law and Social Sciences
faculties.line: Liberal Arts: 36 points with 18 at HL, no set subject. LLB Law: 38 with 18 at HL and the LNAT.

faculties.name: Faculty of Health and Life Sciences
faculties.line: Veterinary Science closes 15 October: 36 points, HL Chemistry and one more science at 6; a questionnaire scores 70%, no routine interview.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science and Engineering
faculties.line: Computer Science: 38 with 18 at HL and a 7 in HL Maths (AA or AI). Aerospace Engineering: 38 with HL Maths 6.

notes: The international fee for the first year of BSc Computer Science in 2027 is £34,700.
Applying after 13 January is allowed for international students, but you are no longer guaranteed equal consideration.
Law applicants must register, book and sit the LNAT by 13 January 2027, earlier than most other LNAT universities.
